text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Found Agnes Digital's student handbook while walking.
Searched academy grounds to return it, then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*...! N-Now I'm totally ready
to cheer at horse girl live concerts!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mastery achieved, Wotagei dance!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Eek!? Oww...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hiee!? Ah-wah-wah-wah!
Did I bump into someone—!?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Eh? No, no! Just snagged
on a tree branch~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I see.
Please take care...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Did I get too carried away
in horse girl sacred paradise garden?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If I really caused someone an injury
just now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaah! Never recover from that!!
No choice but quit otaku life forever!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!! Making all that racket!
I'm in the middle of building new code—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uhyo-haaaah!! Shakur-san!!
Cool as ever! Wild cool!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Told ya shut up! Besides, whining all this
time... keep soliloquies quiet!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uhyi!? Y-You heard that...!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. What's with all that anyway?
Quitting, not quitting crap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Stuff you love, can you really toss it
away that easy?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
! Impossible... impossible!
Otaku activities are Digitan's life!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But this is Tracen Academy, so maybe
I should behave more properly...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Pain in the ass. Who cares. As long as
roles are separated, zero issue.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hacking, defending against hacks—
both are still hackers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Meaning... separation between
supporter side and runner side... wait, huh??

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Can't attack without reading opponent's move.
Can't defend without reading opponent's mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Real deal knows both.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I get it...
I understand now, Shakur-san!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What matters is directing full focus
toward "target" in every single moment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When cheering beloved horse girls,
pour out heartfelt love and shout with full power!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And to polish oneself as horse girl,
must understand fans' hearts!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... thank you, Shakur-san!!
Digitan will love horse girls forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, loud.
Quit following me, annoying.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
At Shakur-san's winning live concerts too,
I'll cheer with full heart and perfected Wotagei!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah!? Why mine?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No worries!! I'll exercise utmost care
not to bother anyone nearby! As true otaku!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: N-

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: NEVER ASKED FOR THAAAAT!!!!!
